title: Scenic Tours of Niagara

services.name: Fireworks Cruise Night Tour
services.desc: One of the most unforgettable Niagara Falls tours, featuring return transportation, a scenic boat cruise, and stunning nighttime fireworks over the Falls. Luxury transportation in a Mercedes Metris or Cadillac Escalade with pickup from your Niagara Falls or Niagara-on-the-Lake accommodation Experience one of the most spectacular Niagara Falls tours available - a premium Niagara Falls sightseeing tour combining iconic attractions, fine dining, and a breathtaking nighttime fireworks cruise. Your evening begins 775 feet above the city at the legendary Skylon Tower. From the observation deck, take in panoramic views of the illuminated Horseshoe Falls, American Falls, and the Niagara skyline.

services.name: Helicopter Ride & Lunch Tour
services.desc: See Niagara by air and water on a guided 5.5 hour tour featuring a helicopter ride, Niagara City Cruises boat tour, Fallsview lunch, and return transportation. Maple Leaf Place visit with guided tasting of three premium Grade A Ontario Maple Syrups and artisan chocolates Experience Niagara from the sky, the water, and the road on one unforgettable guided tour. This premium 5 to 5.5 hour sightseeing experience combines a thrilling helicopter flight, a close-up Niagara City Cruises boat ride, and a three-course lunch overlooking the Falls. Your day begins with convenient pickup from your Niagara Falls, Canada accommodation and fully narrated small-group transportation. Soar above the Falls
